messages:
maria: async check-in — quick one for today
what I did: finished a major pass on the Python quickstart (streaming + sync flows), updated the sample 'chat-hello' to use the new `stream()` helper. docs updated with example snippets.
blockers: sample app e2e failing in CI because REDWOOD_API_KEY not being injected into the runner (works locally).
plan/today: split quickstart into 'basic' and 'streaming' pages, open PR for the sampleapp fix, and file an infra ticket for secret propagation. pinging @kevin for CI secrets.

kevin: saw this. likely the matrix runner uses the wrong env name — we switched to `REDWOOD_KEY` a while back for Dedicated tests. i can patch the runner in the docs repo, but need the PR link to update the workflow and rerun.

maria: PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821
CI error snippet from the failing job:
```
E AssertionError: token missing
env: REDWOOD_API_KEY not set
```
looks like the workflow still expects the old var.

chet: FYI I landed the Node SDK packaging fix yesterday (M1 wheel + linux musl). updated the release notes and bumped the `npm` tag to `beta`. no rollforward needed for docs, but sample apps using node need to set `@redwood/sdk@rc`.
blocker for me: need a quick approval on the build-matrix change so we can cut the RC.

elaine: pushed a small docs redirect and fixed a broken link in the quickstarts nav (the streaming page was 404). also added a migration note about `REDWOOD_API_KEY` vs `REDWOOD_KEY` so users won't be confused. can someone confirm the wording reads OK in the migration section? small excerpt: "If your CI relies on REDWOOD_API_KEY, update to REDWOOD_KEY or add the legacy env var mapping in your workflow."

ci-bot: docs/pr-4821 — smoke-sampleapp-e2e failing (job #5624). logs attached to PR. rerun scheduled on comment.

sam: i'll take the e2e failure this afternoon. i'll re-run the job once kevin patches the workflow. quick note: can we also add a tiny healthcheck to the sampleapp CI that asserts `REDWOOD_KEY` exists before running tests? would save a wasted minutes. :thumbsup:

maria: perfect — thanks @sam and @kevin. i'll split the quickstart pages after the CI is stable and open a follow-up PR to add the healthcheck.

kevin: patching workflows now, will comment on PR when done. ETA ~45 min.

maria: awesome. if anyone wants to review the quickstart text before merge, it's at the PR diff — streaming example uses `async for chunk in client.stream(...)` pattern. i'll leave a note in the PR for reviewers. :wave:
